shortDescription: Book trusted home service providers in your area. Cleaning, plumbing, electrical, aircon, and more.
fullDescription:
onService is the Philippines' home services marketplace, connecting you with verified and vetted local service providers for all your home maintenance needs.

WHAT YOU CAN BOOK:
• General Cleaning — deep clean, regular maintenance, move-in/move-out
• Plumbing — repairs, installation, drain cleaning
• Electrical — wiring, fixtures, troubleshooting
• Aircon Services — cleaning, repair, installation
• Pest Control — termites, rodents, general pest treatment
• Painting — interior, exterior, touch-ups
• Carpentry — furniture repair, installation, custom work
• Appliance Repair — washing machines, refrigerators, and more

WHY ONSERVICE:
• Verified Providers — all service providers undergo background checks including NBI clearance verification
• Transparent Pricing — see upfront prices or request custom quotes before booking
• Secure Payments — pay through GCash, Maya, credit/debit cards via PayMongo with full escrow protection
• Real-Time Tracking — track your provider's arrival and job progress
• Suki Loyalty Program — earn points on every booking and unlock discounts as a loyal customer
• Dispute Protection — if anything goes wrong, our resolution team has your back
• Referral Rewards — invite friends and earn bonus credits

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Search for the service you need
2. Choose a date, time, and your address
3. Get matched with a verified provider or compare quotes
4. Pay securely — funds are held in escrow until you confirm the job is done
5. Rate and review your experience

FOR SERVICE PROVIDERS:
Switch to provider mode to receive job requests, manage your schedule, build your reputation, and grow your business with onService.

SECURITY & TRUST:
• Escrow-protected payments — your money is safe until you confirm satisfaction
• In-app messaging — communicate directly with your provider
• Photo documentation — providers document work for transparency
• 24-hour dispute window — file a dispute if you're not satisfied

Support: support@onservice.ph
Website: https://onservice.ph
